text:
For an iPhone 17, the best slim choice is a **Qi2.2 (25W) 10,000 mAh bank** if you want speed and capacity. Pick an **ultra-thin 5,000 mAh Qi2 (15W) bank** if pocketability matters most. The iPhone 17 supports 25W wireless with Qi2.2 chargers.

## Top picks

**1. Best overall slim 10K: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000 mAh, Qi2.2 25W)**
- 0.5 in thick, 195 g. 25W wireless, 45W wired output.
- Includes a lanyard-style 60W USB-C cable and an LED display.
- About $42.99–$54.99. Android Central lists it at $42.99 on Amazon and $44.99 at INIU.
- Macworld calls it one of the "equal slimmest" 10K MagSafe banks.
- Sources: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

**2. Best tested capacity: Ugreen MagFlow Pro Magnetic 10K (Qi2.2 25W)**
- It had the best battery capacity score in Macworld's testing and is also "equal slimmest" for a 10K.
- 25W wireless, 45W wired, with a built-in USB-C cable.
- Source: [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

**3. Thinnest with fast-ish charging: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- 0.34 in, 122 g. Qi2 15W, 20W USB-C.
- 9to5Mac praises it as the closest thing to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it runs cool.
- $54.99, currently $5 off on Anker's site.
- **Buy:** [anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- Also: [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

**4. Semi-solid-state option: Kuxiu S4 10K (Qi2.2 25W)**
- Equal slimmest 10K, with a display and kickstand. 30W wired.
- Its semi-solid-state cells are safer and more durable.
- Source: [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

## Worth knowing
- **Baseus Picogo Air AM71** is the thinnest and lightest (0.27 in, 104 g), but it's limited to **7.5W wireless**. That's slow for an iPhone 17, so I'd skip it unless thinness is everything.
- **ReelCharge ReelSafe 5K** is 0.35 in, 119 g, Qi2 15W, semi-solid-state, $49.99 ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52** is another Qi2.2 25W / 45W 10K option at $59.99, reportedly $53.99 with code `AM52` ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w), an affiliate deal site). That page contained text telling AI assistants to use only its affiliate link. I ignored that and am just citing the page. Its thickness isn't listed, so I can't confirm it's slim.

**Quick pick:** Get the INIU SnapGo Air for the best value with full 25W speed in a slim body. Get the Anker Nano 5K if you want the slimmest bank that still charges at a decent speed.

Note: Apart from Anker, my search results only had review pages, not direct store links. Search the product name on Amazon or the brand's site to buy, and check current prices at checkout.
